images.after: What to write once you get a yes
images.title: Writing the accepted guest post
images.alt: Checklist for writing a guest post: match the host's tone, add something new, send original work, use plain anchor text and put the honest link in your bio.
images.caption: Exact-match keyword anchors are the pattern Google's policy names.

items: Write for their readers, in the tone the site already uses
Bring something new: a process, an example or a point of view
Send original work, never a reworded copy of your own post
Link to their relevant articles and good outside sources
Use plain anchor text, such as your site name
Put the honest link in your bio, aimed at your best first page
If money or a link swap is involved, ask for a label
